title: Predictors of chronic arthralgia after chikungunya virus infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Chikungunya is an expanding global health threat, with chronic arthralgia representing the main long-term driver of disability. Although many studies have assessed post-chikungunya outcomes, evidence remains fragmented and contradictory. We aimed to identify reproducible predictors of chronic arthralgia (≥3 months) after laboratory-confirmed chikungunya and to distinguish stable prognostic signals from context-dependent associations. Methods We searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and BVS/LILACS from inception to Feb 6, 2026, without restrictions. Eligible studies compared participants with and without chronic arthralgia at follow-up and reported extractable baseline or acute-phase factors. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using QUIPS. Random-effects restricted maximum likelihood meta-analyses pooled odds ratios and mean differences, with subgroup analyses by follow-up window. PROSPERO: CRD420251169320. Results Of 1784 records, 29 studies were included, comprising 4108 participants: 1838 with chronic arthralgia and 2230 without. After harmonization, 22 predictors were meta-analyzed. The most consistent associations were female sex (OR 2.08, 95% CI 1.77–2.46; I2=8.3%), comorbidity presence (1.99, 1.55–2.55; I2=0%), and high blood pressure (1.52, 1.13–2.04; I2=33.4%). In contrast, several acute-phase manifestations and treatment-related markers showed less stable, timing-dependent, or study-sensitive associations. Overall risk of bias was high in most studies and moderate in the remainder. Conclusions Chronic post-chikungunya arthralgia was most reproducibly associated with readily identifiable baseline host factors, rather than with a uniform acute-severity phenotype. These findings suggest that risk stratification should not rely only on acute symptom burden, and that pre-existing vulnerability may define a clinically important high-risk group. Point-of-care identification of patients with these characteristics could support prioritization of follow-up and resource allocation during outbreaks, inform post-outbreak surveillance and guideline development, and may guide future burden-based vaccination strategies in endemic settings.

title: Autochthonous chikungunya virus outbreak in Verona province, Italy, 2025.
abstract: Abstract Background Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, has increasingly caused autochthonous outbreaks in temperate regions, including Italy. In 2025, a local CHIKV outbreak occurred in Verona province, Veneto Region. We report the findings of integrated epidemiological, virological, and entomological investigations. Methods In 2025, a dedicated surveillance protocol was implemented to assess local transmission of arboviral infections in Verona province, enabling early detection of a local CHIKV circulation. Following notification of the index case, investigations were conducted in accordance with the national and regional arbovirus surveillance plans, including comprehensive epidemiological, virological, and entomological analyses. Results The index case was identified on 6 August 2025, with retrospective detection of the first case with symptom onset on 31 July; the primary case was not identified. As of 15 October, 69 cases were reported (62 confirmed, 7 probable), with a mean age of 55 years; 91.3% had identifiable epidemiological links, mainly clustered in two municipalities of the Verona province. Most cases (76.8%) occurred between mid-August and mid-September. The outbreak lasted approximately fifteen weeks, from the end of July to the mid of October. CHIKV-RNA was detectable in whole blood and, less frequently, urine only within the first five days after symptom onset, with higher viral loads in blood. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 主要由伊蚊传播,在包括意大利在内的温带地区越来越多地引起本土 暴发。本研究旨在调查 2025 年威尼托大区维罗纳省的 暴发。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年,实施了专门的 监测 协议来评估维罗纳省当地 传播 虫媒病毒感染,从而能够及早发现当地 CHIKV 循环。暴发 发生在威尼托大区维罗纳省,截至 2025 年 10 月 15 日,涉及 69 例。大多数病例(76.8%)发生在 8 月中旬至 9 月中旬之间,其中 暴发 持续约 15 周,从 7 月底到 10 月中旬。
elements_zh.methods: 通报指示病例后,根据国家和地区虫媒病毒监测计划进行了调查,包括全面的流行病学、病毒学和昆虫学分析。仅在症状出现后的前五天内,全血和尿液中可检测到 CHIKV-RNA,血液中的病毒载量较高。在第 4-5 天可检测到 CHIKV 特异性 IgM 抗体,在第 7-10 天可检测到 IgG。
elements_zh.main_results: 指标病例于2025年8月6日确认,追溯检测首例症状出现时间为7月31日;原发病例未被识别。截至10月15日,报告69例病例(62例确诊,7例可能),平均年龄55岁;91.3%病例具有明确流行病学关联,主要集中在维罗纳省的两个市镇。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 系统发育分析显示,该病毒株在东-中-南非(ECSA)基因型内形成高度均一的单系群,与2024–2025年留尼汪暴发的毒株密切相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 暴发 强调了对虫媒病毒感染保持警惕的重要性,特别是在 CHIKV 传播 可能意外发生的温带地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本次暴发暴发凸显了专用监测监测方案在早期发现发热/疑似虫媒病毒病例中的价值,同时暴露出关键漏洞,即未检测到的原发病例及阴性的媒介学调查结果,表明需降低检测阈值并提前开展基于风险的媒介采样。

title_zh: 意大利维罗纳省2025年本土性基孔肯雅病毒 暴发暴发
source_body_en: Abstract Background Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, has increasingly caused autochthonous outbreaks in temperate regions, including Italy. In 2025, a local CHIKV outbreak occurred in Verona province, Veneto Region. We report the findings of integrated epidemiological, virological, and entomological investigations. Methods In 2025, a dedicated surveillance protocol was implemented to assess local transmission of arboviral infections in Verona province, enabling early detection of a local CHIKV circulation. Following notification of the index case, investigations were conducted in accordance with the national and regional arbovirus surveillance plans, including comprehensive epidemiological, virological, and entomological analyses. Results The index case was identified on 6 August 2025, with retrospective detection of the first case with symptom onset on 31 July; the primary case was not identified. As of 15 October, 69 cases were reported (62 confirmed, 7 probable), with a mean age of 55 years; 91.3% had identifiable epidemiological links, mainly clustered in two municipalities of the Verona province. Most cases (76.8%) occurred between mid-August and mid-September. The outbreak lasted approximately fifteen weeks, from the end of July to the mid of October. CHIKV-RNA was detectable in whole blood and, less frequently, urine only within the first five days after symptom onset, with higher viral loads in blood. CHIKV-specific IgM antibodies were detectable from days 4–5 and IgG from days 7–10. A total of 225 Aedes albopictus specimens were collected, all testing negative for CHIKV. Phylogenetic analysis revealed a highly homogeneous, monophyletic cluster within the East-Central-South African (ECSA) genotype, closely related to strains from the 2024–2025 Réunion outbreak. Conclusions This outbreak underscores the value of dedicated surveillance protocols for early detection of febrile/suspected arboviral cases, while also highlighting key vulnerabilities, namely, an undetected primary case and negative entomological findings, pointing to the need for lower testing thresholds and earlier, risk-based vector sampling.

title: Mosquito diversity and arbovirus detection in Paraguay: first evidence of dengue and chikungunya virus infection in field populations.
abstract: Arboviruses are mosquito-borne viruses of major public health importance, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. In Paraguay, dengue (DENV) and chikungunya (CHIKV) viruses are among the most epidemiologically relevant; however, studies integrating mosquito and arbovirus surveillance remain scarce. This study aimed to characterize mosquito assemblage composition across different ecological settings and investigate arbovirus circulation in field-collected mosquitoes. A total of 4,595 mosquitoes (609 pools) were collected between 2013 and 2024 from urban, rural, and Atlantic Forest environments in Paraguay. Twenty-six mosquito species were identified, with Culex quinquefasciatus (55.3%) as the most abundant, followed by Aedes (Ochlerotatus) scapularis (13.3%). Aedes aegypti (7.3%) was mainly associated with urban areas. Diversity analyses showed higher alpha diversity and greater gamma diversity in the Atlantic Forest and lower values in rural areas, whereas high beta diversity indicated substantial species turnover among locations. Molecular screening by real-time RT-PCR detected no evidence of West Nile, Saint Louis encephalitis, Venezuelan equine encephalitis, Mayaro, yellow fever, Zika, or Oropouche viruses. aegypti pools tested positive for DENV (n=3; 2021 and 2023) and CHIKV (n=3; 2023). Phylogenetic reconstruction confirmed the circulation of DENV-4 Genotype II (lineage B.1.1), DENV-2 Genotype II (F.1.1.2), and CHIKV East/Central/South African (ECSA) lineages in Paraguay, all closely related to human outbreak-associated sequences. These findings provide the first molecular evidence of arbovirus infection in field-collected mosquitoes in Paraguay and emphasize the importance of integrated entomological and viral surveillance.

title: Chikungunya Virus serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings: Mechanisms, Diagnostic implications, and epidemiological consequences
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.
journal: World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the mechanisms of serological cross-reactivity in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in co-endemic settings, emphasizing the challenges it poses for diagnosis and surveillance. The study identifies three distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification. It highlights that cross-reactivity with O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Ross River virus (RRV) is supported by shared antigenic architecture and functional cross-neutralisation, while cross-reactivity with dengue virus (DENV) and Zika virus (ZIKV) lacks a biological basis. The review underscores the need for a layered diagnostic approach, including molecular detection, antigenically informed serology, and neutralisation-based confirmation, along with cross-reactivity-aware statistical models. It also stresses the importance of improving assay validation and confirmatory testing in regions where multiple arboviruses co-circulate.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 会导致急性发热性疾病,并导致 关节痛 衰弱,血清学检测仍然是 诊断 和 监测 的核心。然而,在多种虫媒病毒共同循环的环境中,基于抗体的结果因交叉反应而变得复杂。该综述的重点是共流行环境中的 CHIKV 血清学交叉反应,检查其机制、诊断意义和流行病学后果。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述区分了影响 CHIKV 血清学 的三种相关但不同的现象:生物交叉反应性,由相关病毒之间真正的抗原重叠引起;与检测相关的非目标反应性,其中诊断平台在病毒之间没有建立生物学关系的情况下产生阳性信号;诊断错误分类,将两者混为一谈的下游流行病学后果。将此框架应用于五个病毒对,我们发现CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong病毒(ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro病毒(MAYV)和CHIKV-罗斯河病毒(RRV)关系得到了共享的甲病毒抗原结构的支持,并且在一些研究中还得到了功能性交叉中和的支持。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 这些区别很重要:未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的问题。我们认为,共流行环境中的 CHIKV 诊断 需要分层策略:急性期进行分子检测,随后进行抗原告知和多重 血清学,以及基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),并结合 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 所提供的证据并未报告关于 CHIKV 与所有相关病毒之间交叉反应机制的具体共识。该综述强调,DENV 和 ZIKV 相关血清中的 CHIKV 反应性缺乏既定的生物学基础,被归类为未解决机制的检测相关非靶标反应性。此外,审查指出,没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的问题,这表明当前诊断方法存在差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 加强分析验证和确认性检测,特别是在尼日利亚等 CHIKV、DENV 和相关甲病毒共同传播的非洲地区,对于提高诊断准确性和流行病学推断至关重要。

title: Acute-phase clinical profile and quality of life in patients with chikungunya during the 2025 outbreak in Bangladesh: A facility-based cross-sectional study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bangladesh experienced a notable resurgence of chikungunya cases in 2025, following its last major outbreak in 2017. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological profile of laboratory-confirmed chikungunya cases in Bangladesh. METHODS: This cross-sectional study included and interviewed 442 laboratory-confirmed adult chikungunya cases. Pain was assessed using the Visual Analog Scale (VAS, 0-10) and quality of life was measured via the validated Bangla EQ-5D-3 L instrument, which evaluates five domains-mobility, self-care, usual activities, pain/discomfort, and anxiety/depression. Overall health was rated using the EQ-VAS, a vertical scale ranging from 0 ("worst imaginable health state") to 100 ("best imaginable health state"). Index scores were derived using the trade-off (TTO) valuation set. Associations with the overall EQ-5D index were analyzed using Tobit regression, whereas domain-specific associations were examined via ordinal logistic regression models. RESULTS: Of all, 16.5% of patients required hospital admission, with a median length of stay of 5 days (IQR 3-6), and the rest of them consulted on an outdoor basis. The mean (SD) age of the participants was 45·3 (15·5) years, and 60% were female. Fever (98%) and arthralgia (97%) were the predominant symptoms. Mild pain was reported by 6% of patients, while 40% had moderate and 54% had severe pain, with a median VAS score of 8.0 (IQR 7.0-9.0). Over 70% of the participants reported mobility limitations, self-care, functional impairment, pain or psychological symptoms. The median EQ-5D index was 0·78 (IQR 0·60-0·96). Female sex (β = -0·10, 95% CI -0·17, -0·02) and greater pain severity (β = -0·26, 95% CI -0·37, -0·15) were independently associated with a lower EQ-5D index. CONCLUSIONS: During the outbreak, chikungunya patients in Bangladesh predominantly presented with fever and joint pain and experienced marked declines in quality of life, with women being disproportionately affected.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the acute-phase clinical profile and quality of life of chikungunya patients during the 2025 outbreak in Bangladesh. It included 442 laboratory-confirmed adult cases and assessed symptoms, pain levels, and quality of life using validated instruments. The results showed that fever and arthralgia were the most common symptoms, with severe pain reported by 54% of patients. Women and those with greater pain severity experienced lower quality of life. The study highlights the significant impact of chikungunya on patients' health and the need for targeted interventions. However, the cross-sectional design limits the ability to establish causality, and the findings should be interpreted with caution due to potential biases and confounding factors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 继 2017 年发生最后一次重大 暴发 事件后,孟加拉国于 2025 年经历了基孔肯雅热病例的显着复苏。本研究旨在描述孟加拉国实验室确诊的基孔肯雅热病例的流行病学特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项基于机构的横断面研究包括 442 例实验室确诊的成人基孔肯雅热病例。该研究于 2025 年 暴发 在孟加拉国进行,重点关注前往医疗机构进行评估的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用视觉模拟量表(VAS,0-10)评估疼痛,​​并通过经过验证的 Bangla EQ-5D-3 L 仪器测量生活质量,该仪器评估五个领域:活动能力、自我护理、日常活动、疼痛/不适和焦虑/抑郁。使用 EQ-VAS 对总体健康状况进行评级,垂直等级范围从 0(“可想象的最差健康状态”)到 100(“可想象的最佳健康状态”)。指数得分是使用权衡(TTO)估值集得出的。使用 Tobit 回归分析与总体 EQ-5D 指数的关联,而通过序数逻辑回归模型检查特定领域的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 其中,16.5%的患者需要入院,中位住院时间为5天(IQR 3-6),其余患者在室外就诊。参与者的平均 (SD) 年龄为 45·3 (15·5) 岁,其中 60% 为女性。发烧(98%)和关节痛(97%)是主要症状。6% 的患者报告轻度疼痛,40% 的患者报告中度疼痛,54% 的患者报告重度疼痛,VAS 评分中位数为 8.0(IQR 7.0-9.0)。超过 70% 的参与者报告了行动受限、自我护理、功能障碍、疼痛或心理症状。EQ-5D 指数中位数为 0·78 (IQR 0·60-0·96)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在暴发期间,孟加拉国的基孔肯雅热患者主要表现为发烧和关节疼痛,生活质量显着下降,其中女性受影响尤为严重。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果深入了解了孟加拉国 2025 年 暴发 期间基孔肯雅热的临床概况和生活质量影响,这可以为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施和改善患者护理策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,无法建立因果关系,并且依赖自我报告的数据,可能会引入偏差。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据的强度适中。

title: Divergent climate suitability profiles for dengue and chikungunya transmission by Aedes albopictus in Mauritius
abstract: Abstract Background Empirical surveillance for Aedes -borne arboviruses is inherently reactive, detecting transmission after it has commenced. For small island settings where dengue and chikungunya circulate sporadically, characterising when and where environmental conditions could support local transmission is critical for preparedness. In Mauritius, Aedes albopictus is the sole primary vector for dengue and chikungunya viruses, but previous suitability assessments have relied on Aedes aegypti parameterisation. Methods We estimated monthly Index P for dengue and chikungunya across 160 localities in Mauritius from January 2014 to October 2024. Index P, a mechanistic transmission suitability measure derived from the Ross-Macdonald framework that climate-dependent transmission potential attributable to one adult female mosquito. Mean temperature and relative humidity were derived from ERA5-Land reanalysis dataset via Google Earth Engine and incorporated within the Mosquito-borne Viral Suitability Estimator (MVSE) framework. Index P was also parameterised with Ae. albopictus -specific biological priors and virus-specific vector competence values for both dengue and chikungunya. Results Transmission suitability for both viruses was concentrated within the austral summer (November to April), with near-zero values in winter, below the indicative transmission threshold (Index P ≥ 0.5). Chikungunya exhibited consistently higher, more spatially widespread and longer-lasting suitability than dengue: all districts exceeded the transmission suitability threshold for chikungunya (Index P = 0.71), while median dengue Index P = 0.24, remaining below this threshold, during the same study period. Dengue peak suitability was concentrated in western coastal localities, consistent with the greater thermal sensitivity of its extrinsic incubation period in Ae. Conclusions These findings indicate that dengue and chikungunya have distinct, virus-specific climate-suitability profiles in Mauritius, and should not be treated as interchangeable for preparedness purposes. This provides an important Ae. albopictus -parameterised evidence base for Mauritius, enabling seasonal and geographic targeting of surveillance and vector control ahead of, rather than in response to local transmission.

title_zh: 毛里求斯白纹伊蚊对登革热和基孔肯雅热 传播 的不同气候适宜性概况
source_body_en: Abstract Background Empirical surveillance for Aedes -borne arboviruses is inherently reactive, detecting transmission after it has commenced. For small island settings where dengue and chikungunya circulate sporadically, characterising when and where environmental conditions could support local transmission is critical for preparedness. In Mauritius, Aedes albopictus is the sole primary vector for dengue and chikungunya viruses, but previous suitability assessments have relied on Aedes aegypti parameterisation. Methods We estimated monthly Index P for dengue and chikungunya across 160 localities in Mauritius from January 2014 to October 2024. Index P, a mechanistic transmission suitability measure derived from the Ross-Macdonald framework that climate-dependent transmission potential attributable to one adult female mosquito. Mean temperature and relative humidity were derived from ERA5-Land reanalysis dataset via Google Earth Engine and incorporated within the Mosquito-borne Viral Suitability Estimator (MVSE) framework. Index P was also parameterised with Ae. albopictus -specific biological priors and virus-specific vector competence values for both dengue and chikungunya. Results Transmission suitability for both viruses was concentrated within the austral summer (November to April), with near-zero values in winter, below the indicative transmission threshold (Index P ≥ 0.5). Chikungunya exhibited consistently higher, more spatially widespread and longer-lasting suitability than dengue: all districts exceeded the transmission suitability threshold for chikungunya (Index P = 0.71), while median dengue Index P = 0.24, remaining below this threshold, during the same study period. Dengue peak suitability was concentrated in western coastal localities, consistent with the greater thermal sensitivity of its extrinsic incubation period in Ae. Conclusions These findings indicate that dengue and chikungunya have distinct, virus-specific climate-suitability profiles in Mauritius, and should not be treated as interchangeable for preparedness purposes. This provides an important Ae. albopictus -parameterised evidence base for Mauritius, enabling seasonal and geographic targeting of surveillance and vector control ahead of, rather than in response to local transmission.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 针对伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒的经验 监测 具有固有的反应性,在开始后检测 传播。对于登革热和基孔肯雅热零星传播的小岛屿环境,确定环境条件何时何地能够支持当地 传播 对于做好准备至关重要。在毛里求斯,白纹伊蚊是登革热和 基孔肯雅病毒 的唯一主要 媒介,但之前的适宜性评估依赖于埃及伊蚊参数化。方法 我们估算了 2014 年 1 月至 2024 年 10 月毛里求斯 160 个地区登革热和基孔肯雅热的月度指数 P。指数 P 是一种机械 传播 适宜性衡量标准,源自罗斯-麦克唐纳框架,气候依赖性 传播 可能归因于一只成年雌性蚊子。平均温度和相对湿度通过 Google Earth Engine 从 ERA5-Land 再分析数据集得出,并纳入蚊媒病毒适宜性估计器 (MVSE) 框架中。指数 P 也用 Ae 进行参数化。白纹伊蚊 - 登革热和基孔肯雅热的特定生物学先验和病毒特定 媒介 能力值。结果 传播 对两种病毒的适宜性集中在南方夏季(11 月至 4 月),冬季数值接近于零,低于指示性 传播 阈值(指数 P ≥ 0.5)。基孔肯雅热始终表现出比登革热更高、更广泛、更持久的适宜性:所有地区都超过了基孔肯雅热的 传播 适宜性阈值(指数 P = 0.71),而在同一研究期间,登革热指数中位数 P = 0.24,仍低于该阈值。登革热高峰适宜性集中在西部沿海地区,这与白伊蚊外在潜伏期的较高热敏感性一致。结论 这些研究结果表明,登革热和基孔肯雅热在毛里求斯具有独特的、特定于病毒的气候适宜性特征,并且出于防备目的,不应将其视为可互换的。这提供了一个重要的 Ae。白纹伊蚊 - 毛里求斯的参数化证据库,能够提前控制 监测 和 媒介 的季节性和地理目标,而不是响应当地的 传播。

title: Potential threats of porcine Getah virus outbreaks and its specific antagonism of host antiviral response through proteasome-dependent degradation of P46 by nsP2.
abstract: Alphaviruses are a genus of positive-strand RNA viruses classified in the Togaviridae family. It contains many important human and animal pathogens, such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Sindbis virus (SINV), Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV), Semliki Forest virus (SFV) and Ross River virus (RRV), posing significant threats to public health and animal welfare. As a member of genus Alphavirus, porcine Getah virus (GETV) is re-emerging around in many parts of the world in recent years (2022-2025) and has caused small to large-scale outbreaks of diarrhea related diseases in pig industry. In this study, a virulent porcine GETV (JLy1 strain) was isolated from the intestinal contents of diarrheic piglets. Using AG129 mouse as an infection model, all the infected mice succumbed to JLy1 infection accompanied by the severe intestinal damages. Further studies indicated that GETV also caused diarrhea and damages to the intestine, lung and spleen in 2-day-old piglets, leading to 100% mortality. Meanwhile, a host protein P46 was screened to be obviously downregulated in GETV infected intestinal tissues, suggesting a potential regulatory relationship between GETV infection and endogenous P46 expression. Ectopic expression of P46 inhibits GETV infection, whereas P46 knockout by CRISPR-Cas9 editing significantly promotes GETV replication, indicating P46 as a novel antiviral regulator against GETV infection. Further studies demonstrated that GETV employs a unique mechanism to antagonizes P46 antiviral response via Lys48-linked proteasome-dependent degradation compared to other alphaviruses, including CHIKV, VEEV, SINV, SFV and RRV. Our findings provide insights into the outbreak risks and immune evasion mechanisms of re-emerging GETV, advancing our understanding of GETV pathogenesis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨猪盖塔病毒(GETV)暴发的潜在威胁及其拮抗宿主 抗病毒药物反应的机制。包括GETV在内的甲病毒属披膜病毒科正链RNA病毒属,含有许多重要的人类和动物病原体,如基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)、辛德比斯病毒(SINV)、委内瑞拉马脑炎病毒(VEEV)、塞姆利基森林病毒(SFV)和罗斯河病毒(RRV),对公众健康和动物福利构成重大威胁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及从腹泻仔猪的肠道内容物中分离出强毒力的猪 GETV(JLy1 株)。使用AG129小鼠作为感染模型,所有感染小鼠均死于JLy1感染并伴有严重的肠道损伤。进一步的研究表明,GETV 还会引起 2 日龄仔猪腹泻以及肠、肺和脾损伤,导致 100% 死亡率。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用 AG129 小鼠作为感染模型来评估 GETV 感染的影响。宿主 蛋白 P46 在 GETV 感染的肠道组织中被筛选出下调,表明 GETV 感染与内源性 P46 表达之间存在潜在的调节关系。测试 P46 的异位表达可抑制 GETV 感染,而通过 CRISPR-Cas9 编辑敲除 P46 可促进 GETV 复制。
elements_zh.main_results: 受感染的小鼠死于 JLy1 感染并伴有严重的肠道损伤。GETV 引起 2 日龄仔猪腹泻以及肠、肺和脾损伤,导致 100% 死亡率。筛选出宿主蛋白P46在GETV感染的肠道组织中明显下调。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,P46 作为一种新型 抗病毒药物 调节剂来对抗 GETV 感染。进一步的研究表明,与其他甲病毒(包括 CHIKV、VEEV、SINV、SFV 和 RRV)相比,GETV 采用独特的机制通过 Lys48 连接的蛋白酶体依赖性降解来拮抗 P46 抗病毒药物 反应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供了对重新出现的 GETV 的 暴发 风险和免疫逃避机制的见解,增进了我们对 GETV 发病机制 的理解。这些发现可能为未来开发 GETV 暴发 针对性干预措施的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其使用 AG129 小鼠作为感染模型,可能无法完全代表人类 免疫应答。证据是中等的,因为这些发现是基于体内实验和分子筛查,没有直接的临床或流行病学数据。

title: Chikungunya virus dynamics and persistence in body fluids—Nanning, Guangxi Province, China, 2025
abstract: In 2025, China experienced its largest outbreak of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an acute infectious disease transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. This study aims to analyze the dynamic changes, developmental trends, and persistence of CHIKV in body fluids, based on infection data collected from Nanning, China. A total of 506 specimens were longitudinally obtained from 53 hospitalized patients in Nanning, China. title: Chikungunya in older people: a guide for primary care nurses
abstract: Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne viral infection with an expanding global spread, driven by climate change and increased international travel, leading to more older people and people with long-term health conditions travelling abroad. Chikungunya is characterised by sudden-onset fever and severe joint pain; however, older adults may present atypically, with milder or absent fever and non-specific symptoms, increasing the risk of delayed diagnosis. Pre-travel advice, vaccination and mosquito bite avoidance are key for prevention. This article discusses the epidemiology of chikungunya, differences in clinical presentation between age groups, diagnostic approaches and key considerations for management and prevention.

title: Perfil epidemiológico da Chikungunya em um município no sul do da Bahia, de 2016 a 2024
abstract: Objetivo: Analisar o perfil epidemiológico da febre Chikungunya no município de Itabuna, Bahia, entre 2016 e 2024, com ênfase em variáveis sociodemográficas, manifestações clínicas e critérios diagnósticos. Métodos: Estudo descritivo e retrospectivo baseado em dados do Sistema de Informação de Agravos de Notificação (SINAN). Foram analisados casos notificados no período, com seleção de registros confirmados por critérios laboratoriais ou clínico-epidemiológicos após limpeza dos dados. Variáveis sociodemográficas, clínicas, comorbidades e desfechos foram avaliadas por estatística descritiva, teste qui-quadrado e regressão logística univariada (p<0,05). Resultados: Foram notificados 18.211 casos suspeitos, dos quais 5.309 (29,2%) foram confirmados. Predominaram casos em mulheres (63,9%), residentes da área urbana (89,5%) e confirmação clínico-epidemiológica (70,7%). Os sintomas mais frequentes foram artralgia (72,9%), febre (67,6%) e mialgia (60,4%). Houve pico de casos em 2016 e novo aumento em 2023. Observou-se alta incompletude em variáveis como raça e escolaridade e baixa realização de sorologia. Conclusão: O perfil indica maior acometimento feminino e urbano, além de fragilidades na vigilância epidemiológica local, demandando melhorias no SINAN e no fluxo diagnóstico para políticas locais mais eficazes.
authors: Íris Terezinha Santos de Santana Silva

source_records.title: Perfil epidemiológico da Chikungunya em um município no sul do da Bahia, de 2016 a 2024
source_records.abstract: Objetivo: Analisar o perfil epidemiológico da febre Chikungunya no município de Itabuna, Bahia, entre 2016 e 2024, com ênfase em variáveis sociodemográficas, manifestações clínicas e critérios diagnósticos. Métodos: Estudo descritivo e retrospectivo baseado em dados do Sistema de Informação de Agravos de Notificação (SINAN). Foram analisados casos notificados no período, com seleção de registros confirmados por critérios laboratoriais ou clínico-epidemiológicos após limpeza dos dados. Variáveis sociodemográficas, clínicas, comorbidades e desfechos foram avaliadas por estatística descritiva, teste qui-quadrado e regressão logística univariada (p<0,05). Resultados: Foram notificados 18.211 casos suspeitos, dos quais 5.309 (29,2%) foram confirmados. Predominaram casos em mulheres (63,9%), residentes da área urbana (89,5%) e confirmação clínico-epidemiológica (70,7%). Os sintomas mais frequentes foram artralgia (72,9%), febre (67,6%) e mialgia (60,4%). Houve pico de casos em 2016 e novo aumento em 2023. Observou-se alta incompletude em variáveis como raça e escolaridade e baixa realização de sorologia. Conclusão: O perfil indica maior acometimento feminino e urbano, além de fragilidades na vigilância epidemiológica local, demandando melhorias no SINAN e no fluxo diagnóstico para políticas locais mais eficazes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to analyze the epidemiological profile of Chikungunya virus in Itabuna, Bahia, from 2016 to 2024, focusing on sociodemographic variables, clinical manifestations and diagnostic criteria.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a descriptive and retrospective study based on data from the SINAN system, analyzing cases notified during the period, with data cleaning and selection of confirmed cases through laboratory or clinical-epidemiological criteria.
analysis.methods: Sociodemographic, clinical, comorbidity and outcome variables were evaluated using descriptive statistics, chi-square test and univariate logistic regression (p<0.05).
analysis.main_results: A total of 18,211 suspected cases were reported, of which 5,309 (29.2%) were confirmed. The majority of cases were in women (63.9%), residents of urban areas (89.5%) and confirmed through clinical-epidemiological criteria (70.7%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight a higher prevalence among women and urban populations, and underscore weaknesses in local epidemiological surveillance, suggesting the need for improvements in SINAN and diagnostic flow for more effective local policies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform targeted surveillance and diagnostic strategies in urban areas, particularly for women, and highlight the importance of strengthening the SINAN system for better disease control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: There was incomplete data on variables such as race and education level, and low serology performance, which may limit the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the epidemiological profile of Chikungunya virus in Itabuna, Bahia, from 2016 to 2024, focusing on sociodemographic variables, clinical manifestations and diagnostic criteria. It was a descriptive and retrospective study based on SINAN data, with confirmed cases selected through laboratory or clinical-epidemiological criteria. The study found that 29.2% of 18,211 suspected cases were confirmed, with a higher prevalence among women and urban residents. The results indicated a predominance of clinical-epidemiological confirmation and highlighted weaknesses in local surveillance. The findings suggest the need for improved diagnostic flow and surveillance in urban areas, particularly for women. However, the study had limitations, including incomplete data on race and education and low serology performance, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is considered moderate due to these limitations.

title: Neglected arboviruses in South America: clinical manifestations and diagnostic challenges.
abstract: In South America, the arboviruses that are most noted are those that lead to dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Nevertheless, there are additional arboviruses that trigger outbreaks, yet do not receive adequate attention, including Oropouche virus (OROV), Mayaro virus (MAYV), Saint Louis Encephalitis virus, Madariaga virus (MADV), and Rocío virus (ROCV). A rapid review was conducted using the databases PubMed, LILACS, Scopus, and Google Scholar. This analysis focused on studies that outline the clinical signs and diagnostic methods of neglected arboviruses impacting human populations in South America. A total of 38 studies met the inclusion criteria. Most reports focused on OROV and MAYV, whereas only a few studies described MADV and ROCV. Brazil accounted for the largest proportion of studies, followed by Peru. Across the reviewed literature, these arboviruses were associated with a broad clinical spectrum, ranging from non-specific febrile illness to severe neurological disease and congenital complications. Diagnostic approaches included serological assays, viral isolation or neutralization tests, and molecular methods such as RT-PCR. The increasing spread of these under-reported arboviruses in South America requires strengthening monitoring systems, optimizing access to specific diagnostics, and training healthcare personnel to identify these infections early and manage them appropriately.
journal: Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

title: Effects of different X-ray irradiation dosages on Wolbachia trans-infected and uninfected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Aedes aegypti is a primary vector of several arboviral diseases, including dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever. aegypti can disrupt virus transmission cycles, thereby reducing the incidence of these diseases. Releasing sterile Ae. aegypti males has been implemented to suppress their natural populations, using three approaches, i.e., ionizing radiation-induced sterilization (Sterile Insect Technique, SIT), Wolbachia-induced cytoplasmic incompatibility (Incompatible Insect Technique, IIT), and a combination of both approaches (SIT/IIT). METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: This study investigated effects of different X-ray radiation doses on the ecological fitness of the Thai wild-type and Wolbachia trans-infected Ae. Both wild-type and wAlbB trans-infected Ae. aegypti were irradiated with different X-ray radiation dosages, i.e., 30, 50, and 70 Gy, at the pupal stage. Our results demonstrated reduced fitness parameters in both Ae. aegypti strains when irradiation dosages increased, with greater adverse effects observed in the Wolbachia-infected group. Interestingly, 30 Gy irradiation appeared to prolong the lifespan of wAlbB trans-infected Ae. Male fertility in both wild-type and wAlbB trans-infected mosquitoes irradiated at 50 Gy and 70 Gy was nearly zero. Wolbachia density generally declined with increasing radiation, and higher doses were associated with reduced mating competitiveness. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the effects of different X-ray irradiation dosages on the ecological fitness of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, which are primary vectors of several arboviral diseases, including chikungunya.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a laboratory setting, where both wild-type and Wolbachia trans-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes were irradiated with dosages of 30, 50, and 70 Gy at the pupal stage. The research focused on assessing the impact of these dosages on mosquito fitness and mating competitiveness.
analysis.methods: The study used X-ray irradiation at different dosages to assess the ecological fitness of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. It evaluated parameters such as lifespan, mating competitiveness, and Wolbachia density in both wild-type and trans-infected strains under controlled laboratory conditions.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that increased X-ray dosages led to reduced fitness parameters in both mosquito strains, with greater adverse effects observed in the Wolbachia-infected group. At 30 Gy, wild-type males outperformed Wolbachia-infected males in mating competitiveness, but this was reversed at 50 Gy and 70 Gy. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that 30 Gy is the optimal dosage for sterilizing both wild-type and Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes under laboratory conditions, which could enhance the efficiency of sterile mosquito release programs for disease suppression.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings could inform the development of more effective sterile mosquito release programs to suppress Aedes aegypti populations and reduce the transmission of chikungunya and other arboviral diseases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted under laboratory conditions, which may not fully reflect real-world ecological dynamics. The evidence is moderate, as the results are based on controlled experiments rather than field observations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估不同 X 射线照射剂量对埃及伊蚊生态适应性的影响,埃及伊蚊是包括基孔肯雅热在内的几种虫媒病毒疾病的主要 媒介。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在实验室环境中进行的,野生型和沃尔巴克氏体反式感染的埃及伊蚊在蛹期均接受了 30、50 和 70 Gy 的剂量照射。该研究的重点是评估这些剂量对蚊子适应性和交配竞争力的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用不同剂量的X射线照射来评估埃及伊蚊的生态适应性。它在受控实验室条件下评估了野生型和反式感染菌株的寿命、交配竞争力和沃尔巴克氏体密度等参数。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,增加 X 射线剂量会导致两种蚊子品系的适应度参数降低,在感染沃尔巴克氏体的群体中观察到更大的不利影响。在 30 Gy 的剂量下,野生型雄性在交配竞争力方面优于感染沃尔巴克氏体的雄性,但在 50 Gy 和 70 Gy 的剂量下情况却相反。沃尔巴克氏体密度通常随着辐射剂量的增加而下降,并且在较高剂量下交配竞争力也会降低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,30 Gy 是在实验室条件下对野生型和感染沃尔巴克氏体的埃及伊蚊进行绝育的最佳剂量,这可以提高无菌蚊子释放计划以抑制疾病的效率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更有效的无菌蚊子释放计划提供信息,以抑制埃及伊蚊种群并减少基孔肯雅热和其他虫媒病毒性疾病的 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在实验室条件下进行的,可能无法完全反映现实世界的生态动态。证据是温和的,因为结果是基于受控实验而不是现场观察。

abstract_zh: 背景:埃及伊蚊是多种虫媒病毒疾病的主要 媒介,包括登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和黄热病。埃及伊蚊可以破坏病毒发病率周期,从而减少这些疾病的发病率。释放无菌Ae。已使用三种方法来抑制埃及雄性埃及伊蚊的自然种群,即电离辐射诱导的绝育(不育昆虫技术,SIT)、沃尔巴克氏体诱导的细胞质不相容性(不相容昆虫技术,IIT)以及两种方法的组合(SIT/IIT)。方法/主要发现:本研究调查了不同 X 射线辐射剂量对泰国野生型和沃尔巴克氏体反式感染伊蚊生态适应性的影响。野生型和 wAlbB 均转染伊蚊。埃及伊蚊在蛹期接受不同剂量的X射线照射,即30、50和70 Gy。我们的结果表明,两种 Ae 的适应度参数均有所降低。当辐照剂量增加时,埃及菌株受到影响,在沃尔巴克氏体感染组中观察到更大的不良反应。有趣的是,30 Gy 照射似乎可以延长 wAlbB 反式感染的伊蚊的寿命。在 50 Gy 和 70 Gy 照射下,野生型和 wAlbB 反式感染蚊子的雄性生育力几乎为零。沃尔巴克氏体密度通常随着辐射的增加而下降,而较高的剂量与交配竞争力的降低有关。在 30 Gy 时,野生型雄性在交配竞争力方面优于 wAlbB 反式感染的雄性;但在 50 Gy 和 70 Gy 时则相反。结论/意义:根据实验室条件下不同 X 射线剂量的生态适应性参数和交配竞争力评估,建议使用 30 Gy 对泰国野生型和 wAlbB 反式感染的伊蚊进行灭菌。我们的研究结果旨在提高蚊子无菌释放计划的效率,从而抑制伊蚊。埃及伊蚊 媒介 种群并降低虫媒病毒病 传播 的风险。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估不同 X 射线照射剂量对埃及伊蚊生态适应性的影响,埃及伊蚊是包括基孔肯雅热在内的几种虫媒病毒疾病的主要 媒介。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在实验室环境中进行的,野生型和沃尔巴克氏体反式感染的埃及伊蚊在蛹期均接受了 30、50 和 70 Gy 的剂量照射。该研究的重点是评估这些剂量对蚊子适应性和交配竞争力的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用不同剂量的X射线照射来评估埃及伊蚊的生态适应性。它在受控实验室条件下评估了野生型和反式感染菌株的寿命、交配竞争力和沃尔巴克氏体密度等参数。
analysis_zh.main_results: 结果表明,增加 X 射线剂量会导致两种蚊子品系的适应度参数降低,在感染沃尔巴克氏体的群体中观察到更大的不利影响。在 30 Gy 的剂量下,野生型雄性在交配竞争力方面优于感染沃尔巴克氏体的雄性,但在 50 Gy 和 70 Gy 的剂量下情况却相反。沃尔巴克氏体密度通常随着辐射剂量的增加而下降,并且在较高剂量下交配竞争力也会降低。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,30 Gy 是在实验室条件下对野生型和感染沃尔巴克氏体的埃及伊蚊进行绝育的最佳剂量,这可以提高无菌蚊子释放计划以抑制疾病的效率。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更有效的无菌蚊子释放计划提供信息,以抑制埃及伊蚊种群并减少基孔肯雅热和其他虫媒病毒性疾病的 传播。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在实验室条件下进行的,可能无法完全反映现实世界的生态动态。证据是温和的,因为结果是基于受控实验而不是现场观察。

title: An Overview of Common and Emerging Viral Infections in Humans
abstract: Human life coexists with all other living organisms, ranging from microorganisms to other animals in the ecosystem. Infectious agents can affect the ecosystem’s coherence and remain a significant challenge to human life. Among these, some viruses cause mild infections, while others can have fatal impacts on human life worldwide. Self-acquired genetic variations of viruses pose a significant challenge to efficient control and can trigger severe impacts on human health. The rapid evolution of viruses leads to the emergence of hitherto unknown drug-resistant strains. The current era has witnessed the emergence of several deadly viral infections, such as Corona, Nipah, Ebola, and Zika. Each of these outbreaks underscores the importance of comprehensive research into the improvement of diagnosis, surveillance, treatment, and prevention of the deadliest viral infections. The present chapter outlines viral diseases; Corona, Chikungunya, Ebola, Influenza, and Zika virus infections were selected as representative emerging diseases for detailed discussion.

title: Etiological Spectrum of Acute Febrile Illness in a Tertiary Care Hospital in Assam, India: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Introduction: Acute Febrile Illness (AFI) encompasses a spectrum of conditions marked by fever, often caused by various infectious agents. The aetiological diversity poses challenges in diagnosis and treatment, particularly in regions with limited diagnostic resources. Aim: To evaluate the spectrum of pathogens causing AFI with or without rash in patients. Materials and Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January 2024 to December 2024 on 1,544 patients who had attended Lakhimpur Medical College and Hospital, North Lakhimpur, Assam, India. Patients with fever (≥ 37.5°C) with or without rash were enrolled. Serological investigations for Measles, Rubella, Dengue, Varicella-zoster, Chikungunya viruses, Japanese Encephalitis (JE), Orientia tsutsugamushi, Leptospira, and Hepatitis viruses were performed using Enzyme-linked Immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and Rapid Detection Testing (RDT) kits. Data analysis was performed using both descriptive and inferential methods. A p-value of <0.05 was considered significant. analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study conducted in Assam, India, from January to December 2024 aimed to evaluate the spectrum of pathogens causing Acute Febrile Illness (AFI) with or without rash. The study enrolled 1,544 patients and performed serological investigations for several infectious agents, including Chikungunya virus. The main results showed that fever was prevalent in all cases, with additional symptoms such as headache, cough, and vomiting. The study identified Scrub Typhus, Leptospirosis, Dengue, and Japanese Encephalitis as major causes, with some cases showing co-infection. The authors emphasized the importance of integrated clinical and laboratory approaches for accurate diagnosis and highlighted the need for enhanced surveillance and diagnostic capabilities. The study's findings suggest that seasonal variations in infection rates should be considered in public health planning. However, the study's cross-sectional design limits its ability to establish causality, and the evidence is moderate due to its observational nature.
